notes: 'after this' is added: no source token licenses it, ἔτι being fully realized by 'yet' and no temporal expression standing in the Greek.
τήν before κεφαλήν takes the supplied 'his' under rule 20's second arm, no genitive pronoun standing in the phrase; Ὁ before Παῦλος and τήν before Συρίαν are unrepresented under rule 23.
ἐξέπλει keeps the preverb's 'thence' inside its own unit under rule 106, the following εἰς being rendered 'for', whose gloss does not carry the preverb's sense.
ἀποταξάμενος heads on 'leave' as the meaning-bearing complement of the support-verb phrase, as 18:21 reads the same lexeme.
